propositions: Jira-family-general units (identity convention, probe classifier, link vocabulary, sanitizers, value maps) currently live in the Cloud adapter but are not Cloud-specific and must be extracted to a shared jira_family package to prevent inappropriate cross-adapter imports and duplicate definitions.

The extraction must maintain the acyclic import direction (jira_family has no dependency on adapters/jira/) and use dependency inversion for modules that are loaded by path (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py stay in adapters/jira/ and import from jira_family/).

The probe classifier and sanitizer functions must accept their Cloud-specific configuration (resolved status names, ADF codec, comment limits) as injected parameters rather than importing them, enabling reuse by the future datacenter adapter with its own workflow state names and text formats.

The status and priority maps, currently duplicated in two independent copies with drift (outbound_fields missing the 'deleted' key from jira_fields), must be unified in jira_family/ and adopted by both the ACLI transport and the Backend port.

The deliberate behavior change for deleted status (now resolves to 'Done' instead of invalid 'Deleted') and all imports into location-pinned modules must be absolute (not relative) to survive dynamic loading via spec_from_file_location under synthetic module names.

J1's characterization oracles (30 exact-value pins on Cloud behavior) must pass unmodified; only one J1 import line is re-pointed and zero assertions change, proving the extraction is behavior-preserving.
